Class ManagerGUI

java.lang.Object
ManagerGUI
public class ManagerGUI extends Object
Main graphical user interface for store management operations. Manages tabs for processing orders, tracking order history, managing menu items, viewing inventory, employee records, and generating store reports.

      private static JPanel createProductUsageTab(Connection conn)
      Creates the Product Usage tab panel.

      This tab allows the manager to view what inventory items were used between the 2 timestamps that they can enter.

      Parameters:
      conn - Active database connection for inventory and order data.
      Returns:
      A JPanel configured with timestamp controls and a table view of usage data.
